# Linear Algebra for Data Science

## Single Factor Representation
- Data vector $x_i \approx q_i v$
- Matrix form: $X \approx q v^T$

## Multiple Factor Representation
- Extend to k factors:

$$X \approx Q V^T$$


## Key Concepts
- Subspace, span, linear combination
- Linear independence, basis
- Dimension & rank
- Matrix factorization
- PCA as rank-k approximation
